candidates.name: Ran Ben Shimon
pros: Deep tactical familiarity with the Israeli Premier League
Proven championship pedigree (Ironi Kiryat Shmona, AEK Larnaca)
Available immediately following UEFA Nations League campaign
cons: High-pressure transition immediately after national team exit
Must quickly rebuild locker room confidence after 4-0 Netanya defeat
candidates.summary: Following his resignation from the Israel National Team after the November UEFA Nations League window, Ben Shimon emerged as Ya'akov Shahar and Lior Refaelov's top actionable target. An agreement in principle for an 18-month contract has been reached ahead of a final summit in Tel Aviv.

candidates.name: Edi Iordănescu
candidates.role: Former Romania National Team Head Coach
pros: Guided Romania to top of Euro 2024 group stage
Fits Lior Refaelov's original European profile blueprint
cons: Logistical hurdles bringing full foreign staff mid-season
High wage demands and reluctance to relocate immediately
candidates.summary: Evaluated extensively by Lior Refaelov during the initial foreign coach sweep between Nov 9 and Nov 14. While mutual respect was registered, budget gaps and urgency pushed Haifa toward an immediate domestic solution.

candidates.name: Omer Peretz
candidates.contractTerms: Requires buyout clause release from Hapoel Petah Tikva
pros: Modern attacking philosophy and proactive pressing
Works seamlessly within a Sporting Director structure
cons: Limited experience managing title expectations at Sammy Ofer
Under contract with Hapoel Petah Tikva
candidates.summary: Identified by the scouting department as the leading younger Israeli tactical mind should talks with senior candidates stall.

candidates.name: Barak Yitzhaki
pros: Proven ability to handle massive fanbase pressure and big-club spotlight
cons: Tightly committed to Beitar Jerusalem project
Questions over authority balance alongside Sporting Director Lior Refaelov
candidates.summary: Discussed internally by pundits and board circles as an ambitious domestic swing, though breaking his current contract mid-season was deemed unrealistic.

candidates.name: Sharon Mimar
pros: Consistent overachiever in the Israeli Premier League against top-six clubs
cons: Board preferred a marquee name to calm supporter unrest
candidates.summary: Considered a steady hand capable of stabilizing defensive transitions, kept on the expanded shortlist during week one of the search.

dispatches.title: Morning Briefing: Ran Ben Shimon Set for Final Summit with Ya'akov Shahar Ahead of Bnei Sakhnin Debut
dispatches.excerpt: After agreeing in principle on a 1.5-year contract worth roughly €350,000 per season, Ran Ben Shimon is scheduled to finalize contract clauses with club president Ya'akov Shahar today and lead his first training session at Kfar Galim before the weekend clash against Bnei Sakhnin.
details: Contract duration: 18 months (through end of 2027/28 season) with performance bonuses tied to European qualification.
Annual base salary estimated at €350,000.
Lior Refaelov played a pivotal role in accelerating negotiations within hours of Ben Shimon's Israel National Team departure.

dispatches.title: Evening Update: Breakthrough in Talks — Ben Shimon Agrees in Principle to Take Charge at Sammy Ofer
dispatches.excerpt: What began as quiet backchannel contact turned into advanced contract drafting on Wednesday evening. Both sides bridged gaps over contract length, settling on a year-and-a-half commitment rather than an interim six-month arrangement.
details: Ben Shimon insisted on a multi-season horizon to reshape the squad alongside Lior Refaelov.
Backroom staff alignments are being finalized, retaining existing fitness and goalkeeper coaches at Kfar Galim.

dispatches.title: Morning Briefing: Ran Ben Shimon Steps Down from Israel National Team, Immediately Becomes Haifa's #1 Target
dispatches.excerpt: Following the conclusion of Israel's UEFA Nations League campaign, Ran Ben Shimon officially parted ways with the IFA. Maccabi Haifa's hierarchy wasted no time pivoting from complex foreign negotiations to the newly available veteran manager.
details: Foreign candidates hesitated over mid-season relocation logistics.
Ya'akov Shahar greenlit an immediate approach to Ben Shimon's representatives.

dispatches.title: Evening Update: Foreign Deadlock Prompts Refaelov to Activate Domestic Contingency List
dispatches.excerpt: With the international break winding down and league play resuming against Bnei Sakhnin, Sporting Director Lior Refaelov prepared domestic fallback profiles including Omer Peretz and Sharon Mimar while awaiting clarity on top-tier targets.
details: Interim coaching staff continued running double sessions at Kfar Galim.
Board set a 48-hour internal deadline to appoint a permanent head coach before matchday preparation.

dispatches.title: Morning Briefing: Edi Iordănescu & European Profiles Weighed Against Mid-Season Realities
dispatches.excerpt: Former Romania national team boss Edi Iordănescu remained high on Lior Refaelov's European dossier, but financial demands and requests to overhaul the entire technical staff cooled momentum.
details: Refaelov interviewed three European tactical profiles via video conference over the weekend.
Club veterans voiced preference for a coach who already knows the Israeli Premier League ecosystem.

dispatches.title: Evening Update: Explaining the Authority Balance Between Lior Refaelov and the Next Head Coach
dispatches.excerpt: Analysts highlight a central criterion in Maccabi Haifa's search: the incoming manager must work collaboratively within Lior Refaelov's centralized sporting director model, complicating theoretical links to high-autonomy managers.
details: Transfer policy and January window recruitment will remain jointly managed by Refaelov's scouting unit.
Omer Peretz praised internally for his modern tactical work at Hapoel Petah Tikva.

dispatches.title: Archive Dispatch: Barak Bakhar Resigns in Tears After 4-0 Home Defeat to Maccabi Netanya
dispatches.excerpt: On the night of November 7, 2026, following a stunning 4-0 loss to Maccabi Netanya at Sammy Ofer Stadium, three-time champion head coach Barak Bakhar announced his immediate resignation live on television: 'The team needs a change. I tried, it didn't work.'
details: Bakhar took full personal responsibility for the early 2026/27 slump.
President Ya'akov Shahar and Sporting Director Lior Refaelov convened an emergency morning board meeting on Nov 8 to launch the official head coach search.
